correctness.rationale: The cube's translations and coordinate permutations act transitively on edges, so the graph with edge {0,1} deleted represents all faults. The independent bounded check enumerated all 255 nonempty vertex masks by two cycle tests and confirmed the exact face vectors (8,17,10,2), (8,28,36,14), (8,28,56,60,30,2), (8,28,56,66,40,6) in threshold order. Each sequential-vertex pairing was a matching of codimension-one incidences; topological sorting accepted all vertices of the full oriented Hasse graph at each stage (37,86,184,204 face nodes, respectively). Critical masks in hexadecimal: 01 and {18,24} at degree bound zero; 01 and {2c} at bound one; 01 and {3e,7c,bc} at bounds two and three. The latter three masks each have five vertices. The discrete-Morse CW models have one vertex and cells only in a single positive dimension, making their attaching maps constant and giving the stated wedge homotopy types without relying on field homology. All ten listed collapse pairs were checked in order for codimension one, unique strict coface and exclusion from the target; the 184-face residual is exactly the degree-two subcomplex. Maximal degree three makes this the last transition, and the collapses prove the actual inclusion is a simple-homotopy equivalence. Carnero Bravo's intact formula at n=4 gives one S³ and four S⁴. No map from the intact cube is inferred from the two types.
residual_risks: Full exhaustion is of this particular eight-vertex graph after reduction by symmetry; neither larger cubes nor multiple faults are certified.

evidence: The parameterized forest filtration of K₂×Kₙ stabilizes at degree two and has a prescribed two-degree sphere wedge, but its graphs are all regular.

The general theorem for a proper bipartite subgraph gives two-connectivity of the unrestricted forest complex. Its stronger contractibility clause requires exactly one missing edge relative to Kₐ,ᵦ; five cross edges are missing here.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Two-connectivity leaves both third and fourth homotopy/homology open and gives no relative degree-two stabilization. The extra degree-two vertices in the faulty graph exclude applying the intact parameterized theorem.

value.rationale: The three-cube is a canonical small crown and already has a mix of sphere dimensions; its unique edge-fault orbit is a natural complete experiment in stability of that classification. The exact disappearance of degree three, decrease in degree four, and genuine inclusion-level collapse answer distinct questions beyond a single Betti number. This is useful as a benchmark for a larger fault theory without claiming one.
residual_risks: The value lies in the complete minimal fault class and final inclusion, not in generality over larger cubes or in the map from the intact graph.
